notes.title: Big Update 1.2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png



Greetings!
We are happy to announce the release of the third and final rework update for the game!

We have analyzed your feedback and made significant changes to the game.
Now players have much more freedom and control. Many restrictions have been removed.
Most changes concern combat rules. Now they are clearer and more familiar.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/aadec21b2854d2454150ae9ac03ccd6691bdcf9b.gif



Combat rules changed:

 Players are no longer forcibly pulled into a location when a battle starts.
Now you decide whether to control the organisms yourself or let them fight automatically without your direct control.

 The restriction of having only one squad in battle has been removed.
Now you can send as many organisms into battle as you want.

 You no longer need to finish the battle to leave the location.
Now during battle, you can go to the global map or constructor. The battle will continue automatically without your control.




Campaign missions balanced. To see these changes, restart the current mission or start another:

 A significant number of enemies on locations removed for faster game progression.
 Resource amounts on locations balanced.
 Most locations now have neutral temperature.
 Almost all enemy walls in the campaign have been removed, but they can build them themselves.




Other game improvements:

 Organisms in spore state can now exist for 5 minutes. If not moved to a safe place in time, they will be destroyed.
 Workers on the global map are now animated, making the global map feel more alive.
 Cursor hotspot adjusted for more precise control.
 The "Complete Mission" button has been moved to the top to avoid interfering with the rest of the interface.
 The help button now flashes only 3 times and then turns off automatically.
 Font size increased in some interface elements.
 "Relax mode" is now disabled by default. You can enable it at any time for an easier difficulty level.




[hr][/hr] 
Thank you very much to everyone playing Microcosmum 2! And special thanks to those supporting the game!
We sincerely strive to bring you joy! 

Enjoy the game!

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Update 1.1.10
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png



Hello everyone!
We’ve just released the second update from our major game overhaul package.


In this update, we’ve introduced a new feature: quick organism creation.
We noticed that the current organism creation system was too complex and unnecessarily deep for many players.
To address this, we’ve made the process simpler and faster—since in many cases, players just need a basic organism without going through all the adaptation stages.


The Organism Constructor now includes a new function called “Spawn Organism.”
After designing your organism, you can click this button to immediately begin the spawning process in the incubator. Once it’s complete, the organism will automatically leave the nest.


Of course, the original creation method is still available for those times when you want to leave an organism in the nest to adapt to cold or heat.



[hr][/hr] 
A huge thank you to everyone playing Microcosmum 2! And a special thanks to those who support the game!
We are doing our best to bring you joy! 

Enjoy the game!

[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Update 1.1.9
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png



Hello everyone!
We have released the first update from a large game overhaul package.


[hr][/hr] 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/59b0a616776875f9fac1795afee4726282f7ef65.gif
[hr][/hr] 

In this update, we have given you the ability to choose exactly which part you want to build.
We have added an additional window for selecting parts when constructing a part cocoon.
It displays all the prototypes you have discovered in the game, and new ones will be added as you unlock them.


Previously, when building a part cocoon, a random part was assigned, making this mechanic almost meaningless. Since players obtained many parts from defeated opponents— which was the main way of acquiring them—this mechanic was originally designed to encourage players to build different types of organisms instead of using the same parts repeatedly.
However, after conducting research on this matter, we found that such a situation was unlikely because players receive enough parts from enemies.


Now you can choose which part to build and which one you like best. This provides greater freedom and possibilities in the game and enhances the creative aspect of gameplay.


In the next update, we plan to improve the organism construction system. We will add a quick automatic organism creation feature so that all organism-building actions happen automatically. 
The option to manually create organisms will remain available.



[hr][/hr] 

A huge thank you to everyone playing Microcosmum 2! And a special thanks to those who support the game!
We are doing our best to bring you joy! 

Enjoy the game!


[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Update 1.1.6
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png



 At the request of players, an option to increase the text size was added. In the game options you can now choose one of three text sizes.

 Fixed: Due to an old save, workers could lose orders after entering the map.

 Fixed: In some locations, a blue background was visible outside the location.

notes.title: Update 1.1.5
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png


 Improved calculation of the battle between organisms on the global map. Now the calculations are more complex and take into account all the characteristics of each organism.

 Added the ability to drag and drop the organism project to edit it in the constructor.

 Fixed: In the organism constructor, sometimes the tooltip on the beta organism did not disappear.

 Fixed: In some locations the camera could be moved beyond the permissible limits.

notes.title: Update 1.0.11
notes.notes:
Fixed: Getting the Great Explorer achievement.

 Fixed: Rare memory leak bug after mission completion.

 Minor technical fixes.

notes.title: Update 1.0.10 - Mission 6 map fixed.
notes.notes:
Fixed object positions on mission 6 map.
 Collisions on mission 6 map have been fixed.

Mission 6 may need to be restarted.

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.notes:
Added: Ability to disassemble the organism project in the organism constructor.

 Fixed: Navigation buttons did not appear if you restarted a mission during a battle.

 Fixed: Neutral organisms could be captured after leaving combat. Because of this, the battle did not end.

 Fixed: If you release an organism from the incubator, and then move the organism to a new squad in the squad window, then the release of the next organism would break and the organism would disappear.

 Fixed: The squad button may not be active in the next mission after skipping the tutorial.

 Fixed: If you restart a mission from battle, the navigation buttons will not appear.

notes.title: Update 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Fixed bug escaping from battle.

 Fixed an error in selecting a biomatter miner on the global map.

 Fixed: Mouse click did not work on some game elements.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.notes:
When restarting missions, saved organisms no longer disappear.

 Reduced the strength of mutations from radiation.

 Fixed passages between locations on the global map. They sometimes displayed the texture of the wall.

 Added confirmation window when restarting a mission.

 Improved tutorial.

 Added an indicator when new quests appear.

 Fixed: If you restart a mission after the victory screen, the "End Mission" button does not disappear

 Fixed: After the victory message appeared, it was impossible to close the prototypes window.

 Fixed: It was possible to drag an organism in the constructor for construction in the incubator.

 Fixed: Organism shell on worker icon in incubator.

 Various technical errors have been fixed.



Most of the bugs have already been fixed. We'll fix everything soon)
It is very sad that several minor errors were included in the release.

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Added the ability to restart a mission through the game menu.

 All quest errors in the second mission have been fixed.

 Reduced game difficulty on all missions.

 Fixed a bug on mission 4, when the support squad on the map ended up under the location's decor.

 Wall armor has been reduced.

 The strength of enemy organisms has been reduced.

 The number of enemy turrets on missions has been reduced.

 The number of enemy organisms on missions has been significantly reduced.

 Removed most enemy walls on missions.

 Limits on the construction of miners have been removed.

 Miner construction cost reduced to 30.

 Research that increases the limits on the number of units has been removed. Limits have been removed.

 Research that increases the limits on the number of miners has been removed. Limits have been removed.

 The cost and research time of the harpoon nest has been significantly reduced.

 The button for detailed characteristics of organisms on the interface has been replaced.

notes.title: Update 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Added a skip tutorial button to the game menu.

 Reduced the difficulty of the first boss.

 Fixed: In the tutorial it was possible to kill all enemies before the dialogue about their destruction appeared. This broke further progress.

 Fixed: In the tutorial, it was possible to fire a bomb before the dialogue about its use appeared. As a result, the bomb's cooldown did not reset. This broke further progress.

 Various technical errors have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
The return to location button on the control panel has been enlarged.
 The text on tooltips has been enlarged and adjusted.
 AI behavior has been balanced.
 Debug information is disabled when pressing the F12 key.
 Fixed some bugs in the tutorial.
 Adjusted text size and formatting in many places.
 Increased the size of some buttons.
 The squad limit mechanic has been removed.
 Various technical errors have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Reduced game difficulty.
 Fixed bugs in training.
 Various technical errors have been fixed.

notes.title: Tomorrow release of Microcosmum 2!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39245354/f2d3b7ac25c934b619ea59fbacf7d0906545071d.png
We are pleased to announce that the release of "Microcosmum 2" will take place tomorrow!


Thank you to everyone who has been waiting for the game for so long! We have seen that many players are eagerly awaiting the release of "Microcosmum 2".
Your moral support added inspiration to make the game even better.


This is a very exciting moment for us. "Microcosmum 2" is the result of five years of work by just two people.
The game is created without investors or any other financial support. "Microcosmum 2" is created on our own efforts and resources.


We have put all our experience and love for "Microcosmum" into the game to give you a game that will bring a lot of positive emotions.
A game that will be remembered and become a part of your favorite games collection.


[hr][/hr] 

Don't delay purchasing "Microcosmum 2" for later. Your purchases in the first days after the game's release will greatly help the further success and development of "Microcosmum 2".


We are very excited to release "Microcosmum 2" and are confident that the game will delight you and provide many pleasant experiences!

Enjoy the game tomorrow! :)
